blocks.content: Quiz: By default, how wide is a flexbox?
Tap an option below to answer:
The width of the parent element.
A flexbox can extend to the width of its parent element. But by default, it takes the entire width of the browser screen.
A flexbox can extend to the width of its parent element. But by default, it takes the entire width of the browser screen.
The combined width of the flex items.
The combined width of the flex items doesn't determine the width of a flexbox. By default, it spans the entire width of the browser screen.
The combined width of the flex items doesn't determine the width of a flexbox. By default, it spans the entire width of the browser screen.
The entire width of the browser screen.
By default, flexboxes span the entire width of the browser screen.
By default, flexboxes span the entire width of the browser screen.
The minimum width required to accommodate the flex items without wrapping.
A flexbox's width is not automatically set to the minimum width required to accommodate the flex items. By default, it takes up the entire width of the browser screen.
A flexbox's width is not automatically set to the minimum width required to accommodate the flex items. By default, it takes up the entire width of the browser screen.
